## 1. Frame: The Objective
**Requested Outcome:** [One sentence describing the final goal]
**Target Audience:** [Who is this for?]
**Risk Level:** [Low / Medium / High - High requires manual approval before execution]

## 2. Constraints & Scope
- **In-Scope:** [What must be done]
- **Out-of-Scope:** [What will NOT be changed]
- **Authoritative Sources:** [Links to documentation, live pages, or DB schemas]

## 3. Inspection (Initial)
- [ ] Current live state verified at: [URL/Path]
- [ ] Conflicting sources identified? [Yes/No]
- [ ] Known gaps or missing credentials? [List them]
